description: This file defines the CyclicReferenceStack class responsible for managing a call stack used during spreadsheet calculation to detect cyclic references.

classes.name: CyclicReferenceStack
classes.description: A class to manage a stack of calculated cell references, enabling detection and handling of cyclic references during spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of entries on the calculation stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a new entry onto the calculation stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last entry from the calculation stack.

methods.name: onStack
methods.description: Checks if a given value exists in the stack.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the calculation stack.

methods.name: showStack
methods.description: Returns an array containing all current entries on the stack.
